answer: A dormant account can be reactivated only after the owner passes a fresh identity proof, such as signing with the original key and answering a new challenge. A simple password or an old session is not enough. An attacker who finds a dormant fake identity still faces the same fresh proof as for a live one. A relic out of place triggers the audit: the account is frozen until its proof clears. The wander test catches the lazy fake and the reef test catches the patient one.
